an9.35:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] seyyathāpi bhikkhave, gāvī pabbateyyā bālā abyattā akhettaññū akusalā visame pabbate carituṃ,
an9.35:1.3: ‘yannūnāhaṃ agatapubbañceva disaṃ gaccheyyaṃ, akhāditapubbāni ca tiṇāni khādeyyaṃ, apītapubbāni ca pānīyāni piveyyanti.
an9.35:1.4: sā purimaṃ pādaṃ na suppatiṭṭhitaṃ patiṭṭhāpetvā pacchimaṃ pādaṃ uddhareyya,
an9.35:1.5: sā na ceva agatapubbaṃ disaṃ gaccheyya, na ca akhāditapubbāni tiṇāni khādeyya. na ca apītapubbāni ca pānīyāni piveyya,
an9.35:1.7: yannūnāhaṃ agatapubbañceva disaṃ gaccheyyaṃ, akhāditapubbāni ceva tiṇāni khādeyyaṃ, apītapubbāni ce va pānīyāni piveyyanti, tañca padesaṃ na sotthinā paccāgaccheyya.
an9.35:1.9: tathā hi sā bhikkhave, gāvī pabbateyyā bālā abyattā akhettaññū akusalā visame pabbate carituṃ.
an9.35:1.10: evameva kho bhikkhave idhekacco bhikkhu bālo abyatto akhettaññū akusalo vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an9.35:1.11: so taṃ nimittaṃ na āsevati, na bhāveti, na bahulīkaroti, na svādhiṭṭhitaṃ adhiṭṭhāti.
an9.35:2.2: ‘yannūnāhaṃ vitakka vicārānaṃ vūpasamā …pe… dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihareyyanti.
an9.35:2.3: so na sakkoti vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā …pe… dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharituṃ.
an9.35:2.5: yannūnāhaṃ vivicceva kāmehi …pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihareyyanti.
an9.35:2.6: so na sakkoti vivicceva kāmehi …pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharituṃ.
an9.35:2.7: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, bhikkhu ubhato bhaṭṭho ubhato parihīno. seyyathāpi sā gāvī pabbateyyā bālā abyattā akhettaññū akusalā visame pabbate carituṃ.
an9.35:3.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave gāvī pabbateyyā paṇḍitā byattā khettaññū kusalā visame pabbate carituṃ.
an9.35:3.3: ‘yannūnāhaṃ agatapubbañceva disaṃ gaccheyyaṃ, akhāditapubbāni ca tiṇāni khādeyyaṃ, apītapubbāni ca pānīyāni piveyyanti.
an9.35:3.4: sā purimaṃ pādaṃ suppatiṭṭhitaṃ patiṭṭhāpetvā pacchimaṃ pādaṃ uddhareyya,
an9.35:3.5: sā agatapubbañceva disaṃ gaccheyya, akhāditapubbāni ceva tiṇāni khādeyya, apītapubbāni ca pānīyāni piveyya.
an9.35:3.7: yannūnāhaṃ agatapubbañceva disaṃ gaccheyyaṃ, akhāditapubbāni ceva tiṇāni khādeyyaṃ apītapubbāni ceva pānīyāni piveyyanti’ tañca padesaṃ sotthinā paccāgaccheyya.
an9.35:3.9: tathā hi sā bhikkhave gāvī pabbateyyā paṇḍitā vyattā khettaññu kusalā visame pabbate carituṃ.
an9.35:3.10: evameva kho bhikkhave idhekacco bhikkhu paṇḍito byatto khettaññu kusalo vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi …pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an9.35:3.11: so taṃ nimittaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti svādhiṭṭhitaṃ adhiṭṭhāti.
an9.35:4.2: ‘yannūnāhaṃ vitakka vicārānaṃ vūpasamā …pe… dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihareyyanti’.
an9.35:4.3: so dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ anabhihiṃsamāno vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā dutiyaṃ jjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an9.35:4.4: so taṃ nimittaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti svādhiṭṭhitaṃ adhiṭṭhāti.
an9.35:5.2: ‘yannūnāhaṃ pītiyā ca virāgā …pe… tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihareyyanti’.
an9.35:5.3: so tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ anabhihiṃsamāno pītiyā ca virāgā tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an9.35:5.4: so taṃ nimittaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti svādhiṭṭhitaṃ adhiṭṭhāti.
an9.35:6.2: ‘yannūnāhaṃ sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā …pe… catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihareyyanti.
an9.35:6.3: so catutthaṃ jhānaṃ anabhihiṃsamāno sukhassa ca pahānā …pe… catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an9.35:6.4: so taṃ nimittaṃ āsevati, bhāveti, bahulīkaroti, svādhiṭṭhitaṃ adhiṭṭhāti.
an9.35:7.2: ‘yannūnāhaṃ sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ‘ananto ākāso’ti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja vihareyyanti.
an9.35:7.3: so ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ anabhihiṃsamāno sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā …pe… ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an9.35:7.4: so taṃ nimittaṃ āsevati, bhāveti, bahulīkaroti, svādhiṭṭhitaṃ adhiṭṭhāti.
an9.35:8.2: ‘yannūnāhaṃ sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘anantaṃ viññāṇanti’ viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja vihareyyanti.
an9.35:8.3: so viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ anibhihiṃsamāno sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma anantaṃ viññāṇanti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an9.35:8.4: so taṃ nimittaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti svādhiṭṭhitaṃ adhiṭṭhāti.
an9.35:9.2: ‘yannūnāhaṃ sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma natthi kiñcīti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja vihareyyanti.
an9.35:9.3: so ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ anabhihiṃsamāno sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma natthi kiñcīti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an9.35:9.4: so taṃ nimittaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti svādhiṭṭhitaṃ adhiṭṭhāti.
an9.35:10.2: ‘yannūnāhaṃ sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja vihareyya’nti.
an9.35:10.3: so nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ anabhihiṃsamāno sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an9.35:10.4: so taṃ nimittaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti svādhiṭṭhitaṃ adhiṭṭhāti.
an9.35:11.2: “yannūnāhaṃ sabbaso nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ upasampajja vihareyya’nti.
an9.35:11.3: so saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ anabhihiṃsamāno sabbaso nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an9.35:12.1: yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhu taṃ tadevasamāpattiṃ samāpajjatipi vuṭṭhātipi. tassa muduṃ cittaṃ hoti kammaññaṃ,mudunā
an9.35:12.2: cittena kammaññena appamāṇo samādhi hoti subhāvito.
an9.35:12.3: so appamāṇena samādhinā subhāvitena yassa yassa abhiññāsacchikaraṇīyassa dhammassa cittaṃ abhininnāmeti abhiññāsacchikiriyāya. tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane.
an9.35:13.1: so sace ākaṅkhati anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhaveyyaṃ, ekopi hutvā bahudhā assaṃ bahudhāpi hutvā eko assaṃ …pe… yāva brahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vatteyya”nti.
an9.35:13.2: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane.
an9.35:15.1: so sace ākaṅkhati parasattānaṃ parapuggalānaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajāneyyaṃ
an9.35:15.2: sarāgaṃ vā cittaṃ sarāgaṃ cittanti pajāneyyanti
an9.35:15.18: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane.
an9.35:16.1: so sace ākaṅkhati “nekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussareyyaṃ, seyyathīdaṃ: ekampi jātiṃ dvepi jātiyo …pe… iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussareyya”nti.
an9.35:16.2: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane.
an9.35:17.1: so sace ākaṅkhati dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena …pe… yathākammūpage satte pajāneyya”nti.
an9.35:17.2: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane.
an9.35:18.1: so sace ākaṅkhati “āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭhevadhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyya”nti
an9.35:18.2: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyataneti.
